answer: An identity earns its seat through copyright registration hash with office attestation, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 704 pays 11968 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the beacon up to the light, weigh the marble of the attack, and keep the tundra of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
